_note: Ambitions (scripts/sim/ambition.gd): a direction the player may choose for the nation, not a score. Each is offered when it fits (`for`: "all", "minor" for a nation that is not a great power, "claims" for one with a scenario claim); its state is worked out each month (Ambition.status) and the History book records when it is chosen, given up, achieved or lost. keep_out: never at war with a great power. unify: hold every province of the nation's scenario claims. great_power: rank among the first `rank` nations by output (Rankings).

keep_out.label: Keep out of the great war
keep_out.desc: Whatever the powers do, our people will not fight them.

unify.label: Unify the nation
unify.desc: Bring every land that is ours by right within our borders.

great_power.label: Become a great power
great_power.desc: Grow until the powers have to count with us.
